title: TRTA.Athena.Models.Api.V4.Datasets.NotesRequest
description: Represents a request to add notes or queries to a cell or sheet within a dataset entity.

text.description: The text content of the note or query.

shouldRollForward.description: Indicates whether the note should be rolled forward.

location.description: The location of the note, specifying whether it is associated with a cell or sheet.

rowId.description: The row identifier for the cell where the note or query is located.

columnId.description: The column identifier for the cell where the note or query is located.
